name: Noda Kiyomi
source: An office lady at Selene Girls' High and the wife of Tetsuro Noda, a prefectural assembly member. Kiyomi is a strict woman who respects discipline and despises rock. Though at the second part of the game, she appeared as the band's collaborator, rather than someone who stands in their way.
translation: An office lady at Selene Girls' High and the wife of Tetsuro Noda, a prefectural assembly member. Kiyomi is a strict woman who respects discipline and despises rock. Though at the second part of the game, she appeared as the band's collaborator, rather than someone who stands in their way.
